commits.subject: fix(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Type-ahead, date picker and origin code tidy after the snagging build: one shared test helper per job, no rationale comments, one placeholder vocabulary, in both frontends and the tests repo
test(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): re-point coverage at the tests that now prove the appearance scenarios
chore(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): prove the animals party picker search and the document refusals in full
chore(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): prove the plants address picker search and the potatoes contact task in full
chore(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): prove the plants Back links in full
chore(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): prove the region code prefix and the animals Back links in full
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): CPH number: three labelled boxes as drawn, no cursor jump, and the whole number kept when typed or pasted in one go, in animals
fix(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Review page: an unanswered row in an unfinished review card shows no red bar
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Identification details: Species column, one section per commodity with a bordered card per species, form above the saved animals, no completion message

feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Back links go where the prototype sends them, in animals and plants: the previous step during the opening run, so the run carries on, and the notification list from a submitted notification's view
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Upload documents tidy: one date example, the Welsh file type list, logged refusals and save fallbacks, a right-aligned action column, in both frontends
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Declaration and Notification submitted: wording, links, checkbox and bold date match Design Release 2.1, in animals and plants
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Consignment addresses: one headed section per party showing the full address, with named add links, in animals; 'Consignor' in animals and plants
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Party picker layout: add button, results heading and count, fieldset and blank save, in animals and plants
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Which countries will the consignment travel through?: medium label, search placeholder, no empty-list line, Remove at the right

feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Search boxes with the joined blue icon button on the party pickers and transporter list, the transporter list filtering as you type, and 'Add a transporter' beside the search, in both frontends
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Upload documents: guidance, hints, table and limit error match Design Release 2.1, with a full-width card and the table inside it
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Arrival details wording, hints and transport options match Design Release 2.1, in animals and plants
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Main import reason: heading, child fields and exit date look as Design Release 2.1 draws them
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Every date picker in both frontends has the blue calendar button and a calendar that opens in the page
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Region code prefix shows with JavaScript only: an empty slot, then the picked country's code as soon as it is picked; no prefix without JavaScript
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): 'What are you importing?' and Commodity details: ITAHC inset, search hint, Species column and spacing
feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Origin page wording, country labels and field styling match Design Release 2.1, in animals and plants

feat(design-release-2-1-design-snagging): Type-ahead search boxes look and behave the same on every page in both frontends: page-set placeholder text, bold matching letters and the joined blue magnifying-glass button
